g.text: AI task registry: which task runs where, on which model
Source: src/core/ai/routing.ts (TASK_POLICIES), model-config.ts (DEFAULT_MODELS, MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS), infrastructure/specialist, functions/src/providers.ts
Model id order: Remote Config model_<role>, then EXPO_PUBLIC_AI_MODEL_<ROLE>, then these defaults. The SDK picks the device model when the mode allows it.
Specialists run only through the Cloud Function, with external-provider consent and a stated reason: Claude plans and repairs, Nebius reads sketches. Device models take text only.
